## 1. “我的” (My/Profile) Tab

**Primary file:** `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/app_shell/profile_page.dart`  
**Key class:** `ProfilePage` (ConsumerWidget)

**Shell wiring:**
- Tab host: `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/app_shell/glasses_tab_page.dart` → `GlassesTabPage`
- Tab index 2 = “我的” (`glassesTabIndexProvider` in `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/app_state.dart`)
- Root route `/` → `GlassesTabPage` with `IndexedStack`: `[HomePage, TutorialPage, ProfilePage]`

**Profile UI today:**
| Area | Behavior |
|---|---|
| User header tap | Guest → `context.push(AuthRoutePaths.login)` (`/login`); signed-in → `context.push(ProfileRoutePaths.personalInfo)` (`/profile/personal-info`) |
| **设置** row (`profile-row-settings`) | `context.push(DeviceRoutePaths.settings)` → **`/device/settings`** (device “系统设置”, not app settings) |
| **问题与建议** | `openTutorialTopic(..., TutorialTopic.questionsFeedback)` → H5 via `feature_h5` |
| **关于** | In-app bottom sheet (version/support info) |

**L10n:** `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/l10n/glasses_shell_localizations.dart`  
(`tabProfile` = “我的”, `profileSettings` = “设置”)

## 3. System Settings vs In-App Navigation

Everything is **in-app `go_router` navigation** — no launch to OS Settings (`openAppSettings`, `permission_handler`, etc.) found.

There are **two different “settings” concepts** that share the label “设置” in places:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph tabs [GlassesTabPage /]
    Home[HomePage tab 0]
    Tutorial[TutorialPage tab 1]
    Profile[ProfilePage tab 2 我的]
  end

  Profile -->|user header guest| Login["/login"]
  Profile -->|user header signed in| PersonalInfo["/profile/personal-info"]
  Profile -->|row 设置| DeviceSettings["/device/settings 系统设置"]
  Profile -->|问题与建议| H5Feedback[H5 FAQ]
  Profile -->|关于| AboutSheet[Bottom sheet]

  Home -->|宫格 系统设置| DeviceSettings
  DeviceSettings -->|固件升级| OTA["/device/ota"]
  DeviceSettings -->|most rows| ComingSoon[Toast 功能建设中]

  Showcase[pkg_showcase only] -->|AppSettingsMenu gear| AppSheet[Bottom sheet: 账号/语言/主题]
```

**Naming mismatch:** Profile row label is **“设置”** (`profileSettings`) but destination is **“系统设置”** (`DeviceSettingsPage.pageTitle`). Lanhu doc (`lanhu-ui-pages.md`) still says Profile should use `widget_app_settings`, but implementation diverges.

## Summary for implementers

1. **“我的” page** = `apps/glasses_app/.../profile_page.dart`; settings entry is the **“设置” list row**, which goes to **device system settings**, not app settings.
2. **No account-security page** exists; closest pieces are login/bind-phone/forgot-password/personal-info.
3. **App settings UI** (`AppSettingsMenu`: account, language, theme) lives in `widget_app_settings` but is **showcase-only**; glasses app has providers but no Profile UI for theme/locale.
4. **All navigation is in-app** via `go_router`; device settings items are mostly placeholders except device info sheet and firmware OTA.
